auth.description:
Authenticate to SAP Ariba APIs.

**Option 1: API Key Only**
- Fill in only Application Key and API Base URL.

**Option 2: OAuth + API Key**
- Fill in all fields including OAuth Client ID, Client Secret, and OAuth Server URL.

**Steps:**
1. Log in to the [SAP Ariba Developer Portal](https://developer.ariba.com/api/).
2. Click **Manage** and select your application.
3. **Application Key**: Copy from the **Application Key** field.
4. **OAuth Client ID** (optional): Copy from the **OAuth Client ID** field.
5. **OAuth Client Secret** (optional): Click **Actions** > **Generate OAuth Secret**. Copy immediately.
6. **OAuth Server URL** (optional): Find in **Environment details** (e.g., `https://api.ariba.com`).
7. **API Base URL**: The API runtime URL (e.g., `https://openapi.ariba.com/api/purchase-orders-buyer/v1/prod`).

list_purchase_orders.name: list_purchase_orders
list_purchase_orders.description: Retrieves purchase order header information for a specified buyer.

supplierANID.description: Filter by supplier's Ariba Network ID.

documentNumber.description: Filter by order ID / purchase order number.

startDate.description: Filter orders received on or after this date. Max range: 31 days.

endDate.description: Filter orders received on or before this date. Max range: 31 days.

aiMetadata.description: List purchase order headers from SAP Ariba Network for a buyer (required buyer ANID). Use to find or browse POs; optional filters (supplier ANID, document number, order/routing status, date range capped at 31 days) narrow the results, and leaving them empty returns all of the buyer's orders paginated. Read-only and idempotent.

list_purchase_order_items.name: list_purchase_order_items
list_purchase_order_items.description: Retrieves line item information from purchase orders for a specified buyer.

documentNumber.description: Filter by order ID / purchase order number.

startDate.description: Filter orders received on or after this date. Max range: 31 days.

endDate.description: Filter orders received on or before this date. Max range: 31 days.

aiMetadata.description: List purchase-order line items from SAP Ariba Network for a buyer (required buyer ANID). Use when you need item-level detail rather than PO headers; optional filters (document number, order/routing status, date range capped at 31 days) narrow results, and leaving them empty returns all line items paginated. Read-only and idempotent.

get_document_changes.name: get_document_changes
get_document_changes.description: Returns the list of changes to approvable documents.

changeSequenceId.description: Only return changes after this sequence ID. Leave empty to get all changes.

top.description: Number of records to return (max 1000, default 10).

aiMetadata.description: List changes to approvable documents in a SAP Ariba realm (required). Use to poll for incremental updates: pass a change sequence ID to return only changes after that point, or leave it empty to fetch all changes. Read-only and idempotent.

get_pending_approvables.name: get_pending_approvables
get_pending_approvables.description: List all documents/tasks that are pending approval.

top.description: Number of records to return (max 100, default 100).

aiMetadata.description: List documents and tasks awaiting approval in a SAP Ariba realm (required). Use to find pending approvals; optional filters narrow by approvable type (requisitions, invoices, contracts, payment), user, or password adapter, and leaving them empty returns all pending items. Read-only and idempotent.

get_catalog_items.name: get_catalog_items
get_catalog_items.description: Get list of filtered catalog items for a specific supplier.

supplierId.description: Supplier ID domain value pair (e.g., buyersystemid:Supplier16).

select.description: Output fields to return, comma-separated (e.g., SupplierPartId,SupplierId,LeadTime).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 1000).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve catalog items for a specific supplier and catalog in a SAP Ariba realm. Use to look up product/part data within a known catalog; requires realm, catalog name, supplier ID, and the comma-separated output fields to return, with an optional RSQL filter expression to narrow matches. Read-only and idempotent.

get_active_catalogs.name: get_active_catalogs
get_active_catalogs.description: Get list of active catalog data & supplier values from the specified date.

date.description: Get catalogs activated from this date (ISO format).

supplierdomain.description: Filter by Supplier Domain ID (e.g., buyersystemid:Supplier16).

aiMetadata.description: List active catalogs and their supplier values in a SAP Ariba realm, returning those activated on or after a required date. Use to discover available catalogs; optional filters narrow by supplier domain or subscription name. Read-only and idempotent.

get_facet_data.name: get_facet_data
get_facet_data.description: Get list of Facet data against realm.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve catalog facet data (e.g. distinct classification codes) for a SAP Ariba realm. Use to enumerate facet values for filtering or grouping catalog content; requires realm, the facet field to select, and an RSQL filter expression. Read-only and idempotent.

list_invoices.name: list_invoices
list_invoices.description: Retrieves header information of one or more invoices in Ariba Network.

includeInvoiceProfile.description: Display Invoice Profile related fields (e.g., Address, Tax Id).

aiMetadata.description: List invoice headers from SAP Ariba Network for a given Ariba Network ID (required). Use to find or browse invoices; optional filters narrow by buyer/supplier ANID, document number, document/routing status, document purpose, and creation or status-update date ranges, and leaving them empty returns all invoices paginated. Read-only and idempotent.

search_contract_workspaces.name: search_contract_workspaces
search_contract_workspaces.description: Search contract workspaces based on attributes such as title, contract ID, region, etc.

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

select.description: Comma-separated metadata fields to retrieve (e.g., title,contractid,region).

count.description: Include total number of records in response.

aiMetadata.description: Search contract workspaces in a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, and password adapter). Use to find contracts by attributes when you do not have an exact ID; an optional filter expression narrows matches and leaving it empty returns all accessible workspaces paginated. Read-only and idempotent.

get_contract_workspace.name: get_contract_workspace
get_contract_workspace.description: Search for a contract workspace using a unique identifier.

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single contract workspace by its contract ID from a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, and password adapter). Use when you already know the exact contract ID; for attribute-based discovery use Search Contract Workspaces instead. Read-only and idempotent.

create_contract_workspace.name: create_contract_workspace
create_contract_workspace.description: Create a new contract workspace in SAP Ariba Contracts.

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

templateId.description: Template ID for the contract workspace.

additionalFields.description: Additional fields as JSON object to merge with the request body.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new contract workspace in a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, password adapter, and a title). Use to start a new contract; optional fields set template, dates, amount/currency, owner, and supplier. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate workspace.

update_contract_workspace.name: update_contract_workspace
update_contract_workspace.description: Update an existing contract workspace in SAP Ariba Contracts.

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

contractId.description: The ID of the contract workspace to update.

silentUpdate.description: Update without changing the last modified date.

additionalFields.description: Additional fields as JSON object to merge with the request body.

aiMetadata.description: Update fields (title, description, dates, amount/currency, amendment reason) on an existing contract workspace in a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, identified by contract ID and acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, and password adapter). Idempotent: repeating the call with the same field values converges to the same state.

update_contract_status.name: update_contract_status
update_contract_status.description: Change the status of a contract workspace (e.g., amend, putOnHold, resume, close).

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of.

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user.

contractId.description: The ID of the contract workspace.

action.description: The status change action to perform.

isTemplateUpgradeRequired.description: Whether template upgrade is required (for Amend action).

aiMetadata.description: Perform a status-change action on a contract workspace in a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, identified by contract ID and acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, and password adapter). The action prop selects the transition: amend, completeAmendment, putOnHold, resume, or close (amend also takes an amendment type and reason). Not idempotent: each call drives a state transition that depends on the contract's current status.

delete_contract_workspace.name: delete_contract_workspace
delete_contract_workspace.description: Delete a contract workspace in SAP Ariba Contracts.

realm.description: Name of the SAP Ariba Contract site (e.g., testrealm).

user.description: User ID to perform the action on behalf of (e.g., testUser).

passwordAdapter.description: Password adapter to authenticate the user (e.g., PasswordAdapter1).

contractId.description: The ID of the contract workspace to delete (e.g., CW0001).

aiMetadata.description: Delete a contract workspace by its contract ID from a SAP Ariba Contracts realm, acting on behalf of a user (requires realm, user, and password adapter). Use to permanently remove a workspace. Idempotent: once deleted, repeating the call leaves the workspace gone.

de.\nAuthenticate to SAP Ariba APIs.\n\n**O:
Authentifizieren Sie sich bei SAP Ariba APIs.

**Option 1: API-Schlüssel**
- Füllen Sie nur Anwendungsschlüssel und API-Basis-URL ein.

**Option 2: OAuth + API-Schlüssel**
- Füllen Sie alle Felder einschließlich OAuth Client-ID, Client Secret und OAuth Server URL aus.

**Schritte:**
1. Melden Sie sich im [SAP Ariba Developer Portal](https://developer.ariba.com/api/).
2. Klicken Sie auf **Verwalten** und wählen Sie Ihre Anwendung aus.
3. **Anwendungsschlüssel**: Kopieren Sie aus dem **Anwendungsschlüssel** Feld.
4. **OAuth Client ID** (optional): Kopiere aus dem **OAuth Client ID** Feld.
5. **OAuth Client Secret** (optional): Klicken Sie auf **Aktionen** > **OAuth Secret**. Kopieren Sie sofort.
6. **OAuth Server URL** (optional): Finden Sie in **Umgebungsdetails** (z.B. `https://api.ariba.com`).
7. **API Base URL**: Die API runtime URL (z.B. `https://openapi.ariba.com/api/purchase-orders-buyer/v1/prod`).

fr.Automate procurement, contracts, and inv: Automatiser les achats, les contrats et les factures avec SAP Ariba.
fr.The Application Key for your application: La clé d'application pour votre application.
fr.The OAuth Client ID (optional, for OAuth: L'identifiant du client OAuth (optionnel, pour l'authentification OAuth).
fr.The OAuth Client Secret (optional, for O: Le secret du client OAuth (optionnel, pour l'authentification OAuth).
fr.The OAuth Server URL (optional, e.g., ht: L'URL du serveur OAuth (optionnel, par exemple, https://api.ariba.com).
fr.\nAuthenticate to SAP Ariba APIs.\n\n**O:
Authentifier aux API SAP Ariba.

**Option 1 : Clé API uniquement**
- Remplissez uniquement la clé d'application et l'URL de base de l'API.

**Option 2: OAuth + API Key**
- Remplissez tous les champs, y compris l'identifiant du client OAuth, le secret du client et l'URL du serveur OAuth.

**Étapes :**
1. Connectez-vous au [portail du développeur SAP Ariba](https://developer.ariba.com/api/).
2. Cliquez sur **Gérer** et sélectionnez votre application.
3. **Clé d'application** : Copiez dans le champ **Clé d'application**.
4. **OAuth Client ID** (facultatif) : Copie depuis le champ **OAuth Client ID**.
5. **OAuth Client Secret** (facultatif) : Cliquez sur **Actions** > **Générer OAuth Secret**. Copiez immédiatement.
6. **OAuth Server URL** (facultatif): Trouvez dans **les détails de l'environnement** (par exemple, `https://api.ariba.com`).
7. **URL de base de l'API**: L'URL d'exécution de l'API (par exemple, `https://openapi.ariba.com/api/purchase-orders-buyer/v1/prod`).

pt.\nAuthenticate to SAP Ariba APIs.\n\n**O:
Autenticar para SAP Ariba APIs.

**Opção 1: Chave API**
- Preencher apenas a Chave Aplicativa e URL Base API.

**Opção 2: OAuth + API chave
- Preencha todos os campos, incluindo o ID do cliente OAuth, o Segredo do Cliente e o URL do servidor OAuth.

**Passos:**
1. Entre no [Portal de Desenvolvedor SAP Ariba ](https://developer.ariba.com/api/).
2. Clique em **Gerenciar** e selecione seu aplicativo.
3. **Chave da Aplicativo**: cópia do campo **Chave da Aplicação**.
4. **ID do cliente OAuth** (opcional): cópia do campo **ID do cliente OAuth.
5. **Segredo do cliente OAuth (opcional): Clique em **Ações** > **Gerar segredo OAuth**. Copie imediatamente.
6. **URL do Servidor OAuth** (opcional): Encontre em **Detalhes do ambiente** (por exemplo, `https://api.ariba.com`).
7. **URL da Base da API**: A URL do tempo de execução da API (por exemplo: `https://openapi.ariba.com/api/purchase-orders-buyer/v1/prod`).
